```{r}
plotDoubletUmap <- function(obj, qcDir_v, runName_v = NULL, sid_v, print_v = T) {
  #' Plot Doublet UMAP
  #' @description compute a quick UMAP on singlets + doublets and save one
  #' PNG per sample colored by scDblFinder class (the doublets must still
  #' be in the object, since they are the point of the plot). Normalization
  #' happens on a local copy: the caller's object keeps raw counts only.
  #' @param obj seurat object with scDblFinder.class in metadata
  #' @param qcDir_v directory to output the doublet_umaps subfolder
  #' @param runName_v optional run name prefix for the file name
  #' @param sid_v sample ID for the file name and title
  #' @param print_v logical, print to console
  
  ### Output folder and file name
  umapDir_v <- file.path(qcDir_v, "doublet_umaps")
  dir.create(umapDir_v, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  prefix_v <- if (!is.null(runName_v)) paste0(runName_v, "_") else ""
  outFile_v <- file.path(umapDir_v,
                         paste0(prefix_v, sid_v, "_doublet_umap.png"))
  
  ### Quick normalization for the QC UMAP
  suppressMessages({
    obj <- NormalizeData(obj, verbose = FALSE)
    obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, nfeatures = 2000, verbose = FALSE)
    obj <- ScaleData(obj, verbose = FALSE)
    obj <- RunPCA(obj, npcs = 20, verbose = FALSE)
    obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:20, verbose = FALSE)
  }) # suppressMessages
  
  ### UMAP with doublets drawn on top of the singlets
  nDbl_v <- sum(obj$scDblFinder.class == "doublet")
  pct_v <- round(100 * nDbl_v / ncol(obj), 1)
  plot_gg <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "scDblFinder.class",
                     cols = c(singlet = "grey75", doublet = "#D55E00"),
                     order = c("singlet", "doublet")) +
    ggtitle(sprintf("%s: %d doublets (%.1f%%)", sid_v, nDbl_v, pct_v))
  
  ### Print
  #if (print_v) print(plot_gg)
  
  ### Save
  ggsave(outFile_v, plot_gg, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 150)
  
} # plotDoubletUmap
```

```{r}
# This is latest one, need to modify
removeDoublets <- function(seurat_lsobj, qcDir_v, sampleNameCol_v = "orig.ident", runName_v = NULL, print_v = T) {
  #' Remove Doublets
  #' @description remove doublets from seurat objects with scDblFinder (per
  #' sample, before merging) and save one UMAP per sample colored by
  #' singlet/doublet
  #' @param seurat_lsobj list of seurat objects. Can also provide a single object (will get turned into a list w/ one object)
  #' @param qcDir_v directory to output the qc summary table and doublet UMAPs
  #' @param runName_v optional run name prefix for output files
  #' @param print_v logical whether to print QC umap to console or not
  #' @param sampleNameCol_v where to get sample ID for list construction if only one object given
  
  ### Allow a single object instead of a list (name it from its metadata,
  ### otherwise names(seurat_lsobj) is NULL and the loop below never runs)
  if (is(seurat_lsobj, "Seurat")) {
    sid_v <- unique(as.character(seurat_lsobj[[sampleNameCol_v]]))[1]
    if (is.na(sid_v) || sid_v == "") sid_v <- "sample1"
    seurat_lsobj <- setNames(list(seurat_lsobj), sid_v)
  } # fi
  
  dbl_rows <- list()
  seuratOut_lsobj <- list()
  
  for (sid in names(seurat_lsobj)) {
    
    ### Get an object and its cells
    obj <- seurat_lsobj[[sid]]
    nCells_v <- ncol(obj)
    
    ### Skip if too small
    if (nCells_v < 10) {
      dbl_rows[[sid]] <- data.table(sample_id = sid, cells = nCells_v,
                                    doublets = 0, pct_doublets = 0)
      seuratOut_lsobj[[sid]] <- obj
      next
    } # fi
    
    # One failing sample must not kill the run: keep it unfiltered
    res <- tryCatch({
      
      ### Runs on raw counts (Seurat object converted to a SingleCellExperiment)
      ### set.seed makes calls reproducible.
      ### Default dbr.per1k = 0.008 implements the 10x multiplet rate (~0.8% per 1,000 cells)
      set.seed(42)
      
      ### Convert
      sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(obj, assay = "RNA")
      
      ### Run finder
      sce <- suppressMessages(scDblFinder::scDblFinder(sce))
      
      ### Get order (should always be the same...)
      m <- match(colnames(obj), colnames(sce))
      
      ### Add calls (and scores) to the object metadata, BEFORE removal
      obj$scDblFinder.class <- as.character(sce$scDblFinder.class)[m]
      if (!is.null(sce$scDblFinder.score)) {
        obj$scDblFinder.score <- as.numeric(sce$scDblFinder.score)[m]
      } # fi
      
      ### Per-sample UMAP colored by singlet/doublet (own tryCatch: a plot
      ### failure must not stop the removal)
      tryCatch(
        plotDoubletUmap(obj, qcDir_v, runName_v, sid, print_v),
        error = function(e) warning(sprintf(
          "Doublet UMAP failed on %s (removal continues): %s",
          sid, conditionMessage(e)))
      ) # tryCatch
      
      ### ID doublets
      is_doublet <- obj$scDblFinder.class == "doublet"
      
      ### Output
      list(obj = obj[, !is_doublet], doublets = sum(is_doublet))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      
      warning(sprintf("scDblFinder failed on %s (kept all cells): %s",
                      sid, conditionMessage(e)))
      list(obj = obj, doublets = NA_integer_)
      
    }) # tryCatch
    
    ### Split trycatch output into object and summary
    seuratOut_lsobj[[sid]] <- res$obj
    dbl_rows[[sid]] <- data.table(sample_id = sid, cells = nCells_v,
                                  doublets = res$doublets,
                                  pct_doublets = if (is.na(res$doublets)) NA_real_
                                  else round(100 * res$doublets / nCells_v, 2))
    
    message(sprintf(" %s: %s doublets (%s%%)", sid, res$doublets,
                    dbl_rows[[sid]]$pct_doublets))
  } # for
  
  ### Combine output
  dbl_summary <- rbindlist(dbl_rows)
  
  ### Update
  message(sprintf("Doublet removal done: %s doublets total",
                  sum(dbl_summary$doublets, na.rm = TRUE)))
  
  ### Get name
  if (!is.null(runName_v)) {
    outName_v <- paste0(runName_v, "_qc_doublets.csv")
  } else {
    outName_v <- "qc_doublets.csv"
  } # fi
  
  ### Write summary
  writeCSVorExcel(dbl_summary, file.path(qcDir_v, outName_v))
  
  ### Return singlets
  seuratOut_lsobj
} # removeDoublets
```

# Summary

In this markdown we will perform the following processing steps:

1. Filter out doublets 
1. Visualize data to check results of filters
1. Save finalized seurat object for later use

Must have run part1 first

# Load

Load samples (1.5 min)

```{r, eval = T}
seurat_lsobj <- readRDS(seuratFile_v)
invisible(gc())
```

# scDblFinder

Run scDblFinder on each sample separately, save a UMAP visualizing the doublets

```{r}
tictoc::tic()
seurat_lsobj <- removeDoublets(seurat_lsobj, qcDir_v = qcDir_v)
tictoc::toc()
```


```{r saveObject}
outFile_v <- file.path(rdsDir_v, "qcAndDoubletFilter_lsobj.rds")
tictoc::tic()
saveRDS(object = seurat_lsobj, file = outFile_v)
tictoc::toc()
```
